messages:
Alex: Quick RFC slotting — team, we need to fill 3 author slots for Thurs RFC review (10:00, 10:20, 10:40 PT). Please reply with preferred slot or "any". I'll lock by EOD today.

Maria: Any for me — prefer 10:20.

Sam: Can do 10:40. Also what's expected for pre-read? 1 pager + PTAL link?

Alex: yep 1-pager + link to PR. Put docs in the RFC folder. Example:
```
RFCs/2026-03-runtime-opt/README.md
PR: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1234
```

Rachel: I'd like to review 10:00 slot. Can I take lead reviewer on that one?

Tanvi: heads up — I'm OOTO 10:20-11:00. If Maria wants 10:20 she conflicts with my calendar? (not sure) — can swap if needed.

Jordan: proposal: order by impact + readiness: runtime opts (ready) -> routing policy (draft) -> batching notes (ops). So 10:00 runtime, 10:20 batching, 10:40 routing. Ok?

Maria: ok with that order.

Sam: fine if we shorten each to 12m + 3m buffer? So: 12 + 3, 12 +3, 12 +3 = 45m total.

Alex: good idea. I'll update invite and add pre-read reminder 24h + 2h. Also ping authors: @Maria @Sam @devops-bot can you post a reminder tomorrow at 9am PT?

devops-bot: scheduled reminder set: channel #eng at 2026-03-25 09:00 PT. :bell: 

Rachel: small ask — can we attach the checklist to the calendar invite? I'll add link.

Alex: done. checklist: https://internal.redwood.com/rfcs/checklist

Tanvi: swapping 10:20 -> 10:40 works for me if Sam moves to 10:20. Sam?

Sam: ok i'll take 10:20 instead.

Alex: locked: 10:00 Rachel (runtime), 10:20 Sam (batching), 10:40 Maria (routing). Pre-reads due by 24h before; I'll post final agenda by EOD. thx :thumbsup:
